acceptanceCriteria: JT-AC-031: every applicable iPhone and Watch function is operable with approved accessibility technologies and sensory alternatives.
JT-TEST-063 through JT-TEST-069 record VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, nonvisual state communication, appearance and contrast, Reduce Motion, alternative input, and iPhone size/orientation behavior.
Simulator and automated results remain distinct from required physical-device and human accessibility evidence.
notes: Planning complete for SP-014. Create a defect Issue for any observed approved-requirement violation rather than expanding this Task with unrelated feature work.
Do not claim VoiceOver quality, touch-target usability, contrast, route behavior, or physical-device operation from a build alone.
rationale: Accessibility is a release-critical cross-platform acceptance boundary and must precede safety-warning qualification.
testSteps: Run JT-TEST-063 through JT-TEST-069 against both platforms where applicable, recording exact device, OS, accessibility configuration, route, steps, and observed result.

Exercise VoiceOver pitch spelling and octave speech, Dynamic Type reflow, nonvisual state communication, contrast and appearance, Reduce Motion, Voice Control or Switch Control alternatives, and supported iPhone layout conditions.
Separate deterministic automated checks, simulator inspection, and physical-device evidence; retain unresolved physical evidence for user verification.
